name: Rostarr: Evolving Landscapes
location: Desa Potato Head
description: On Friday, 16 October 2026, Desa Potato Head will unveil Evolving Landscapes, the third chapter of its Cultural Exchange Series and Korean-American artist Rostarr’s largest, most intricate work yet. The programme will bring together art, Balinese ritual, music, projection mapping and fashion across Potato Head Beach Club & Klymax Discotheque. Created entirely freehand without stencils, Evolving Landscapes draws on Rostarr’s signature Graphysics visual language, combining the discipline of East Asian calligraphy with bold geometric forms. A self-guided digital tour invites visitors to explore individual glyphs and details, accompanied by Rostarr’s memories, references and observations behind the 1,644 m² façade. The event also features an on-site pop-up for a capsule collection made with Japanese label nonnative , which showcases the label’s utilitarian aesthetic incorporating Evolving Landscapes’ monochrome motifs. Doors open at 3 PM , when Potato Head Beach Club becomes an open-air dancefloor. Archie, Ryosuke Fukunaga, Yuka Mizuhara, Eric Duncan, Alex From Tokyo and Suze Ijó will take turns behind a Rostarr hand-painted DJ booth until midnight. At 5.30 PM , the conversation moves to Klymax for Desa Dialogues, where Rostarr and Daniel Mitchell , Creative Director of Potato Head and founder of Space Available , will discuss their 17-year creative relationship and the journey from the Green Bus.

name: Steps of Hope: Breast Cancer Charity Walk
location: Sudamala Resort Sanur
description: October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, also known as ‘ Pinktober ’, a global health campaign that draws crucial attention to this life-threatening disease, promotes education, and encourages early detection. Bali Pink Foundation invites you to join its fundraising charity walk on Saturday, 17 October 2026. Founded in 2013 by breast cancer survivor Gaye Warren, Bali Pink Ribbon Foundation has since screened and provided treatment to thousands of women across Indonesia. Throughout the year, the foundation organises regular breast cancer awareness programmes and breast screenings for local communities in Bali and beyond. ‘Steps of Hope’ , in collaboration with Sudamala Resort Sanur , is the foundation’s annual fundraising event. This ‘Pink Charity Fun Walk and Run’ brings people together for a morning walk in Sanur, fully dressed in pink, to raise awareness of breast cancer in solidarity with the foundation and other survivors.

description: Southeast Asia’s biggest literary event, Ubud Writers & Readers Festival (UWRF), returns this 21 to 26 October with a powerful programme of over a hundred separate events. For its 23rd year, authors, thinkers, journalists, poets and more will descend upon Ubud for a week of insight and intrigue. The theme this year is ‘Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action.’, which will guide UWRF’s main programme’s many curated conversations and panels. 150 of the region’s most current, exciting writers will discuss the transformative power of storytelling and its ability to mobilise and enlighten individuals, communities and humanity. As always, the UWRF festival carefully selects its Main Programme speakers, whose works, knowledge and life experiences add poignance, depth and reality into each year’s discussions. A highly-anticipated speaker is Tari Lang , author of the memoir ‘ My Neighbour, The Dictator,’ in which she recounts her life as a fourteen-year-old girl in 1965 when General Suharto’s coup saw her parents imprisoned without trial, and how this history continues to shape who she is.

name: Shows on Ice! First time in Bali
location: Nuanu Creative City, Beraban, Kediri, Tabanan
description: Bali’s First Ice Season at BLOCK42, Nuanu For the first time in Bali, BLOCK42, Nuanu welcomes a spectacular season of live ice shows, bringing together professional figure skating, circus performance, theatre and immersive visual technology on a real ice rink built especially for the occasion. The season features two large-scale productions: Aladdin and the Famous Stories from 1001 Nights on Ice (2 shows: 31 October 2026 starting at 16:00 and starting 19:00) takes audiences into the legendary world of Scheherazade, Aladdin, Ali Baba and Sinbad. Expect breathtaking skating, acrobatics, daring jumps and spins, fire juggling, hula hoops, magic tricks, spectacular costumes and large-scale video projections inspired by the atmosphere of the East. Alice in Wonderland on Ice (2 shows: 01 November 2026 starting at 13:00 and starting 16:00) reimagines Lewis Carroll’s timeless story through figure skating, circus artistry and immersive digital scenography. Alice and the unforgettable characters of Wonderland come to life through complex choreography, acrobatics and striking visual effects that transform the venue into a surreal fantasy world. Two stories. Two spectacular productions. One ice rink in the heart of Bali. A unique live experience for families, children and adults, combining the elegance of figure skating with the energy of contemporary circus and the magic of theatre. How to Choose Your Show and Seats The performances are available on different dates and at different session times. Please select your preferred session when purchasing your ticket. Each session corresponds to a specific performance, date and show — Aladdin and the Famous Stories from 1001 Nights on Ice or Alice in Wonderland on Ice. After selecting your session, you can use the venue seating plan to choose your preferred seating area and available seats. Please check the show title, date and session time carefully before completing your booking, as different sessions may feature different productions. Children Policy Children under 12 years old must be accompanied by a parent or responsible adult aged 18 or over. Children aged 0–4 may attend with a Kids Ticket. This ticket does not include a separate seat, and the child must sit on the lap of the accompanying adult during the performance. Children aged 5 years and above require a regular ticket with their own seat. Ketentuan Anak Anak di bawah usia 12 tahun wajib didampingi oleh orang tua atau orang dewasa yang bertanggung jawab berusia 18 tahun ke atas. Anak usia 0–4 tahun dapat masuk dengan Kids Ticket. Tiket ini tidak termasuk tempat duduk terpisah, dan anak harus duduk di pangkuan orang dewasa yang mendampingi selama pertunjukan. Anak usia 5 tahun ke atas wajib memiliki tiket reguler dengan tempat duduk sendiri. The Venue BLOCK42, Nuanu, Bali, Indonesia Inside Nuanu Creative City BLOCK42 is located in Nuanu, the creative city on Bali’s west coast. Please check the event page for the exact venue location, entrance details and directions. A purpose-built ice arena The venue features a specially installed ice rink together with a full-scale production setup including professional lighting, sound and large-format video projection — creating a complete theatrical ice-show experience. Doors open 1 hour before the show We recommend arriving early to allow enough time for entry and seating. Latecomers may be admitted during a suitable pause in the performance to avoid disturbing the audience. Parking & drop-off Drop-off and parking are available within Nuanu. Scooter parking is located close to the venue entrance, while car parking is available a short walk away. Please allow additional time for parking and walking to BLOCK42 before the show. **Venue layout is indicative and may be subject to change without prior notice. Tickets: https://megatix.co.id/events/shows-on-ice-first-time-in-bali
